text: Ask them "music or quiet?" If a song seems to be making things worse, change it, and keep any music low anyway. This is a bad time to defend the playlist. When you talk to them, slow down and use fewer words. Please don't explain the universe at somebody who is already frightened by it. Offer them water without pushing it on them, and if they drink, have them take it in sips, since a lot of water fast is dangerous on MDMA.
section: Psychological First Aid: The First Five Minutes
reader: someone looking after a person in a frightening psychedelic or MDMA state, in the first few minutes, once the immediate dangers (keys, stove, roads, more of the substance) are dealt with

sentences.payoff: the helper learns to ask the person music or quiet
sentences.follows: his question about the music, after the room paragraph

sentences.s: If a song seems to be making things worse, change it, and keep any music low anyway.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns to change a song that seems to be making it worse, and to keep any music low in any case
sentences.follows: what to do with the music once they've answered

sentences.s: This is a bad time to defend the playlist.
When you talk to them, slow down and use fewer words.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns to slow down and use fewer words when talking to the person
sentences.follows: after the music, the helper's own voice

sentences.s: Please don't explain the universe at somebody who is already frightened by it.
Offer them water without pushing it on them, and if they drink, have them take it in sips, since a lot of water fast is dangerous on MDMA.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns to offer water without pushing it, and, if the person drinks, to have them sip, because a lot of water fast is dangerous on MDMA
sentences.follows: the last thing the helper offers; the paragraph ends on why sipping matters

checked.point: a lot of water fast is dangerous on MDMA
checked.found: MDMA raises antidiuretic hormone while people drink heavily, which can drop blood sodium (hyponatremia), with seizures and brain swelling; the guide's MDMA section and its sodium warnings already rest on this
checked.still_needed: yes: it is why sipping matters, which a fresh reader asked

placement: after the room paragraph, in one paragraph: the music (his paragraph), then how to talk, then water (what was left of his fixes paragraph, in his words)

question_text.Q2: What is each instruction for, said in the reader's terms, and is it something the helper does ("have someone go with them"), not a rule stated as a fact ("someone goes with them")?
